title: Simulate energy deposition for 63Ni beta spectrum
action: Set up and run a Monte Carlo electron transport simulation of a GaN stack consisting of p-GaN (80 nm), i-GaN (600 nm), and n-GaN (80 nm) on a silicon substrate. Use the full 63Ni beta emission spectrum as an isotropic electron source. Run at least 50,000 primary particles. Record the depth-resolved average energy deposited per incident primary electron.
description: Depth-dependent energy deposition curve for the 63Ni isotopic source.
output_schema: Columns: depth_nm (float, nanometres from the surface into the material, positive), energy_deposition_eV_per_electron (float, eV deposited per incident primary electron). At least 100 equally spaced depth points covering 0–800 nm.

title: Simulate energy deposition for 17.4 keV electron beam
action: Set up a second Monte Carlo simulation for the same GaN stack, but this time with a monoenergetic 17.4 keV electron beam normally incident on the top surface (p-GaN). Run at least 50,000 primary electrons. Output the depth-resolved energy deposition as for the spectrum case.
description: Depth-dependent energy deposition curve for a 17.4 keV monoenergetic electron beam.
output_schema: Same as step 1: depth_nm (float), energy_deposition_eV_per_electron (float), at least 100 equally spaced depth points spanning 0–800 nm.
